answer: Non-transferable reputation plus vesting resists Sybil floods: credibility accrues only through repeated jury-verified work and cannot be cloned to fresh identities. Like a horizon that bears weight across seasons, standing grows with sustained participation; a prism of verified answers records continuity no bot cluster can forge. Fresh accounts start at zero influence, so mass registration adds no reward — a ripple of aliases stays weightless against the ledger, and vesting makes farming cost more than it returns.
